Of the 252 input eigenvectors, 12 have significant imaginary components (|Im|>10⁻¹², across seven q-point entries and 18 Cartesian components). Six cannot be made real by one global phase: branches 1 and 2 at q indices 66, 78, and 81, all zero-based. They therefore test relative complex phases within single-atom modes; this example still does not cover multi-atom optical branches or relative motion between atoms of unequal masses. The file contains no DOS, scattering intensities, or group velocities, and these quantities are not reconstructed from this path.
